scope: Watermarked long-image preview and mobile file-sharing behavior in the existing shared photo flow. Browser capabilities are simulated; real app menus and delivery to another platform still need a phone check.

browser.command: source tools/runtime-env.sh && DIRMAP_BROWSER_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome npm run test:browser -- tests/browser/photos.spec.ts

verified: A throwing native sharing capability check cannot change a successful export into a failure.
All three formats still download; only the long image has an in-page preview.
The preview contains the full three-photo watermarked image and scrolls without hiding its close control in portrait and landscape.
Native sharing receives a complete generated PDF File directly from a user gesture.
Cancelling or denying sharing keeps the downloaded file and shared photos.
The existing offline upload, lost reply, shared replacement and finish-version cleanup scenarios continue to pass.
